sentences.text: One square. {wrap}Wrap three more around it, {four}and you get a square of four.
sentences.spoken: One square. Wrap three more around it, and you get a square of four.

sentences.text: Wrap the next odd number, five, {nine}and the square grows to three by three.
sentences.spoken: Wrap the next odd number, five, and the square grows to three by three.

sentences.text: Seven more: {sixteen}four by four. Nine more: {twentyfive}five by five.
sentences.spoken: Seven more: four by four. Nine more: five by five.

sentences.text: {each}Each odd number is exactly one more L around the square.
sentences.spoken: Each odd number is exactly one more L around the square.

sentences.text: Look at the fourth L. {col}It is a column of four cells {row}and a row of three: {seven}seven, the fourth odd number.
sentences.spoken: Look at the fourth L. It is a column of four cells and a row of three: seven, the fourth odd number.

sentences.text: In general, L number k is {colk}a column of k {rowk}and a row of k minus one: {total}two k minus one cells.
sentences.spoken: In general, L number k is a column of k and a row of k minus one: two k minus one cells.

sentences.text: That is exactly the step from one square to the next: {diff}k squared minus k minus one squared.
sentences.spoken: That is exactly the step from one square to the next: k squared minus k minus one squared.

sentences.text: Now add up the first n odd numbers, {rewrite}writing each one as a difference of two squares.
sentences.spoken: Now add up the first n odd numbers, writing each one as a difference of two squares.

sentences.text: {cancel}Each square cancels its neighbour, {survive}and only n squared minus zero survives.
sentences.spoken: Each square cancels its neighbour, and only n squared minus zero survives.

sentences.text: {result}So the sum of the first n odd numbers is n squared, {every}for every n.
sentences.spoken: So the sum of the first n odd numbers is n squared, for every n.

sentences.text: Odd numbers stack into squares. {kth}L number k adds two k minus one cells, {sum}and together the first n make n squared.
sentences.spoken: Odd numbers stack into squares. L number k adds two k minus one cells, and together the first n make n squared.
